Not all neoclouds are created the same way not all neocloud capacity is worth the same, and this chart shows it.

Every gigawatt Nebius signs away in a long-term hosting deal brings in roughly $20-25B. 

The same gigawatt sold short-term on its own platform brings in $40-50B. Same power, same data center, about double the revenue.

Serverless inference is the purest version of that. 

Instead of renting a cluster for five years, customers pay per token for exactly what they use, while Nebius runs the hardware, the software and the optimization in between.

Why I think it's the next big leg for 
$NBIS
:

+ Training is lumpy and driven by a few giant customers. Inference is every company shipping an AI product, every single day.
+ Usage-based pricing scales with adoption. More agents means more tokens, which means more revenue from the same gigawatt.
+ The software is the moat. Uptime guarantees, speculative decoding and auto-scaling are hard to copy for someone who's just renting out racks.
+ It spreads revenue across thousands of customers instead of a couple of hyperscalers.

The big contracts pay for the build but inference is where the money is.

Bet on the companies that are pushing for more server-less inference.

For me, that’s
